candidates.source_name: e-Prokurimi — Kosovo national e-procurement platform (SPIN_PROD)
candidates.why_relevant: Mandatory national portal where every Kosovo contracting authority publishes contract notices (njoftim per kontrate), award notices (njoftim per dhenie te kontrates), tender dossiers and signed contract PDFs. This is the single richest named-vendor-plus-price evidence base for banking IT, card/ATM/POS, treasury and payment-gateway procurement by state bodies. Individual notice documents are addressable, e.g. .../SPIN_PROD/application/ipn/DocumentManagement/DokumentPodaciFrm.aspx?id=3489060. Site offers sq/sr/en interface.
candidates.access_status: public web, some areas require economic-operator login
candidates.legal_status: official public-sector publication, open by procurement law
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Prefer the OCDS API over HTML; otherwise crawl notice documents by id via DokumentPodaciFrm.aspx and filter on CPV codes for banking/IT/payment services and on keywords (pagesa, kartela, bankomat, POS, thesar).
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search (sq) for award-notice phrasing + fetch of portal home
queries_used: e-Prokurimi Kosove njoftim per dhenie te kontrates sistem pagesash
Posta e Kosoves tender prokurimi njoftim kontrate

candidates.source_name: Kosovo PPRC/KRPP OCDS bulk data publication (OCP Data Registry entry)
candidates.why_relevant: KRPP publishes Kosovo procurement in Open Contracting Data Standard via API, covering the full cycle: plans, tender, bidders, buyer, supplier, method, tender and contract value. This is the machine-readable route to a complete vendor-award timeline for payment/banking IT, avoiding HTML scraping entirely. Registry entry documents known quality issues (null fields, 'award' vs 'awards' array typo).
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Pull OCDS releases from the registry-listed API endpoint, normalise to a supplier x buyer x value table, then filter on CPV 48000000/66000000/30000000 families and payment keywords.
candidates.discovered_via_method: English search on OCDS + Kosovo, snowballed from e-Prokurimi
queries_used: Kosovo e-prokurimi OCDS API open contracting data standard PPRC publish

candidates.source_name: KRPP — Komisioni Rregullativ i Prokurimit Publik (Public Procurement Regulatory Commission)
candidates.why_relevant: Regulator and operator of e-Prokurimi. Publishes standard notice forms, annual public-procurement reports (aggregate spend by authority and by contract type), legislation, and news. Its annual reports are the fastest way to size the state IT/payments procurement wallet and identify the largest contracting authorities to then drill into.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic crawl of /njoftimet and the annual-report/publication section; extract PDF annual reports for aggregate statistics.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sq search for the regulator by official name
queries_used: KRPP Komisioni Rregullativ i Prokurimit Publik Kosove njoftimet e kontratave

candidates.source_name: OSHP — Organi Shqyrtues i Prokurimit (Procurement Review Body), decisions and complaints registry
candidates.why_relevant: Binding complaint decisions name the complainant and the winning bidder, and often disclose technical specification disputes, evaluation scores and pricing — richer competitive detail than the award notice itself. Has a searchable procurement-activity search, complaint tables by year (2013-2026) and a blacklist of economic operators. Ideal for mapping which integrators fight over bank/payment IT lots in Kosovo.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Query the ProcurementActivities/Search endpoint by contracting authority (MF/Thesari, ASHI, Posta, Trusti, municipalities) and harvest decision PDFs; also snapshot the blacklist periodically.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sq search for review body; archive subdomain snowballed from results
queries_used: OSHP Organi Shqyrtues i Prokurimit Kosove vendimet ankesa oshp.rks-gov.net

candidates.source_name: OSHP archive site (arkivaoshp.rks-gov.net)
candidates.why_relevant: Holds the legacy corpus of OSHP decisions that the current portal may not expose, giving deeper historical continuity on vendor disputes for payment/banking IT tenders.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off deep crawl for historical baseline; low refresh frequency.
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowball from OSHP search results
queries_used: OSHP Organi Shqyrtues i Prokurimit Kosove vendimet ankesa

candidates.source_name: AQP — Agjencia Qendrore e Prokurimit (Central Procurement Agency)
candidates.why_relevant: Runs centralised/framework procurement on behalf of many Kosovo state bodies. Framework contracts for IT, cards, printing and services signed here bind multiple ministries at once, so a single AQP award can determine a vendor's access to the whole public sector.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor the agency's notices/contracts pages for framework agreements (kontrata kornize) touching IT and payments.
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowball from e-Prokurimi homepage link list
queries_used: e-prokurimi.rks-gov.net homepage fetch

candidates.source_name: Open Procurement Transparency Portal — prokurimihapur.org (Levizja FOL)
candidates.why_relevant: Independent, cleaned mirror of Kosovo public contracts awarded since 2010, with filtering by authority and company. Very useful as a cross-check and for pre-2016 history that predates e-Prokurimi, letting you build a long vendor time series for payment/banking IT.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Search by company name for known payment/banking integrators; scrape result tables; treat as secondary to OCDS for authority.
candidates.discovered_via_method: English search on Kosovo procurement transparency portals
queries_used: Open Procurement Kosovo database contracts KDI prokurimi transparency portal

candidates.source_name: Integrity Watch Kosova (KDI / Transparency International Kosova)
candidates.why_relevant: Launched Dec 2025; combines public procurement, political financing and asset declarations with automated red-flag indicators, and shows which companies repeatedly win contracts from which institutions. Excellent for detecting incumbent lock-in and politically connected local partners in payment/IT tenders — exactly the partner-risk layer a vendor entering Kosovo needs.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Company- and institution-level queries; export or scrape contract lists; capture red-flag annotations as qualitative signal, not fact.
candidates.discovered_via_method: English search on KDI/Integrity Watch; snowballed from OCP article
queries_used: Integrity Watch Kosova contracts database integritywatchkosova.org public contracts

Public reporting already shows negotiated contracts with FREEBALANCE KOSOVA SH.P.K (approx EUR 800k support/licences; approx EUR 134,874 for the SIMFK-to-e-Procurement sub-module, Oct 2023) — a concrete incumbent to track.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Track the ministry's procurement/notices page plus all e-Prokurimi and OCDS records where the buyer is MFPT or Thesari; keyword filter on SIMFK, thesar, pagesa, licenca.

candidates.why_relevant: The central bank operates the national payment system (interbank clearing) and is itself a buyer of payment infrastructure, security and IT. candidates.source_name: ASHI — Agjencia e Shoqerise se Informacionit / eKosova platform (state e-services payment gateway owner)
candidates.why_relevant: ASHI runs eKosova, which takes card payments for public services from any bank — meaning ASHI procures acquiring, gateway and integration services. It is the natural buyer for state payment-gateway work and a key reference account for whichever local acquirer/PSP won it. ASHI has also been the subject of a National Audit Office IT project-management audit.
candidates.access_status: public but social-platform gated for bulk access
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use as an actor pointer: resolve ASHI's official rks-gov domain and then query e-Prokurimi/OCDS with ASHI as buyer; use the social channel only for announcement timing.

candidates.why_relevant: Performs dedicated procurement audits and IT audits (including an audit of IT system project management at the Information Society Agency). Audit reports name contracts, values, deficiencies and unmet specifications — often the only place where the failure and cost overrun story behind a payments/IT contract is documented.

negative_findings.description: Serbian-language (sr, Cyrillic) searching for Kosovo contract-award notices on payment/banking systems returned only Republic of Serbia procurement documents (mfin.gov.rs, prosveta.gov.rs, uap.gov.rs), not Kosovo ones. No Kosovo-specific sr-language procurement source was located in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Query 'Косово јавне набавке обавештење о додели уговора платни систем банкарски софтвер' surfaced zero Kosovo-domain results; all hits were Serbian state bodies.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The e-Prokurimi portal exposes a Srpski interface, and Kosovo-Serb-majority municipalities are contracting authorities, so sr-language evidence almost certainly exists but is not reachable via generic Cyrillic web search — it must be pulled from inside the portal's sr locale. Without this, coverage of northern municipalities is at risk.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated procurement/tender page was found on trusti.org (Kosovo Pension Savings Fund) or for Posta e Kosoves in this pass, despite both being in the cell's named buyer list.
negative_findings.result_summary: sq searches returned corporate/press material and quarterly 'Trustorja' reports, not notice listings. Posta e Kosoves queries returned generic e-Prokurimi and municipality results.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: These are two of the most payments-relevant state buyers (pension disbursement; postal financial services and counter payments). Their notices must instead be reached via e-Prokurimi/OCDS filtered by buyer name, which adds a dependency on buyer-name normalisation.

negative_findings.description: A fetch of the e-Prokurimi homepage returned no explicit link to a public notice-search page; only links to KRPP, OSHP and AQP plus an economic-operator notice.
negative_findings.result_summary: Homepage acts as an informational shell; individual notices are reachable at deep SPIN_PROD DocumentManagement URLs found via search engines rather than via a discoverable search form.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: This is a hypothesis about site structure, not a verdict on availability — the search/browse function is likely behind a JS app or a login. Collection design should assume the OCDS API is the primary path and HTML is fallback.

negative_findings.description: No award notice naming the vendor(s) behind the eKosova card-payment gateway was located in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches confirmed eKosova accepts debit/credit card payments across banks and that ASHI operates it, but did not surface the acquiring/PSP contract or its winner.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: That contract is arguably the highest-signal single award in the cell — it identifies the acquirer/PSP trusted with government-wide card acceptance. It should be targeted directly in the OCDS pull with ASHI as buyer.

coverage_gaps.description: Serbian-language coverage of Kosovo procurement is effectively unaddressed: no sr-locale Kosovo source was reached, and no sr glossary of Kosovo-specific procurement terms was validated against live Kosovo documents.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enter e-Prokurimi and KRPP in their Srpski locale and capture the sr equivalents in use there (obavestenje o ugovoru, obavestenje o dodeli ugovora, narucilac, ekonomski operater, platni sistem), then re-run discovery against Kosovo-Serb-majority municipality sites on kk.rks-gov.net.

coverage_gaps.description: Several named-in-scope buyers were not resolved to a concrete notice source: Posta e Kosoves, ATK (Administrata Tatimore e Kosoves, tax collection), KEK and water utilities, and the Kosovo Assembly's procurement directorate.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build an explicit contracting-authority roster from the KRPP annual report, then resolve each to (a) its e-Prokurimi buyer identifier and (b) its own website notice page; prioritise ATK and Posta for revenue-collection payments.

coverage_gaps.description: The exact OCDS API base URL and its auth/rate-limit behaviour for Kosovo PPRC were not captured — only the registry entry pointing to it.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Open the OCP Data Registry publication page for Kosovo, extract the live API/bulk-download endpoint and update frequency, and test a small pull before committing to a collector design.

coverage_gaps.description: No CPV-code filter set has been defined for banking, card, ATM/POS, treasury and payment IT within the Kosovo classification, so keyword-only filtering will over- and under-collect.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Derive a CPV shortlist (48000000 software, 66000000 financial/banking services, 30144200/30123600 cash and ticket machines, 72000000 IT services) from actual Kosovo notices and validate recall against a hand-labelled sample of known awards such as the SIMFK/FreeBalance contracts.

coverage_gaps.description: Pre-2016 procurement history predates e-Prokurimi and may only exist in prokurimihapur.org and the OSHP archive; continuity of the vendor time series is unverified.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Backfill 2010-2016 from prokurimihapur.org and arkivaoshp.rks-gov.net and reconcile supplier names against the modern OCDS records.

brief: Kosovo's public e-procurement evidence base is unusually good for a small market: a single mandatory portal (e-Prokurimi, run by KRPP) publishes contract and award notices plus tender dossiers and signed contract PDFs, and KRPP additionally republishes the whole cycle as machine-readable OCDS through an API — so the primary collection path should be the API, not HTML scraping. Around that core sit three high-value complements: OSHP complaint decisions (which name losing and winning bidders and expose specification and evaluation disputes), National Audit Office procurement and IT audits (which document overruns and failures), and independent mirrors prokurimihapur.org and the new KDI Integrity Watch Kosova platform (which give pre-2016 history and repeat-winner red flags). The payments-relevant buyers are concretely identifiable — Treasury/MFPT for SIMFK (incumbent FreeBalance Kosova), the Central Bank for national payment-system infrastructure, ASHI for the eKosova card-payment gateway, plus Customs, ATK, Trusti, public enterprises and 38 municipalities. The main weaknesses in this pass are Serbian-language coverage, which generic Cyrillic search does not reach and must be pulled from the portal's own sr locale, and the absence of a confirmed OCDS endpoint and CPV filter set.
